title: have you seen this woman?!
content: (this looks long but i promise its not that bad ahah) the first time i remember dreaming of mall world i couldn’t have been older than 4. i am now almost 20. the same woman has been haunting my mall world dreams since the very first one. as a young child, she showed up a lot, now she only makes an appearance maybe once a year. only at mall world. she always wants the same thing. the first time i met her, she told me she needs to ‘steal my breath’. i remember crying to my mum about it. as i grew up, the woman once explained briefly that it was because she needed my soul. after that encounter years ago, she doesn’t really say much, its kind of a silent understanding of what she wants, and that i cant give it to her. idk why. it feels like life or death but i cannot let her take it. she uses these contraptions resembling an oxygen mask (like the clear thing that covers your mouth and nose). she’ll chase me and fight me to try pin me down and get the mask on me. once or twice she managed to get it on me, but i held my breath and managed to fight her off. it had been maybe a year since i saw her last, until the other night. i was on what i think is the top floor of the mall. a big dark red (lounge?) area, with a bar to the side and dim lighting. i was looking for something. then someone tapped me on the shoulder and it was her. i immediately started to run and scream for help but no body even looked my way. it hard to tell you what she looks like. ive seen her for years, her aura is imprinted in my brain yet when i try to think of her face it just a blur. i literally forget her face the second i wake up. i feel like she has dark hair though. short like a bob with heavy bangs. but i could be wrong because her appearance turns into a blur. been searching all this time trying to figure out who she is and why she wants me specifically. after finding this group im one step closer to finding out. anything helps! thank you if you read this far :)
